kind: must-be-deep
depth: deep
reason: deep-depends-on
-- base/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "a" {
  name = "a"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "b" {
  name = "b"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "c" {
  name       = "c"
  depends_on = [aws_sqs_queue.a]
}
-- head/main.tf --
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "a" {
  name = "a"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "b" {
  name = "b"
}

resource "aws_sqs_queue" "c" {
  name       = "c"
  depends_on = [aws_sqs_queue.b]
}
